thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for generation API in region us-west1. Error rate spike starting ~1749304200. Paging on-call (pager duty): @sara

sara: on it. seeing a big spike in 502/504 from the gateway logs. digging into loadbalancer first. linking grafana: https://grafana.example/redwood/d/abc123/generation?var-region=us-west1

alex: I can help. Quick check: are backend pods healthy? last deploy was ~6h ago. could be a bad runtime patch.

mike: I'm pulling recent runtime logs from the inference hosts. noticing repeated `KV cache miss` then `OOM` in some containers followed by connection resets. Not universal but concentrated on a subset of hosts (hostnames list in my SSH session).

sara: can you gist the exact error lines? also checking the LB 5xx distribution across AZs. if it's single AZ, we can shift traffic away.

mike: gist: `2025-02-04T21:45:12Z ERROR runtime: alloc failed: out of memory, pid=2134` then `502 gateway: upstream reset` for same session ids.

alex: that suggests a memory regression on that runtime build. we should fail traffic away from the affected instance pool. proposing temporary traffic reweight to favor us-east1 until rollback.

sara: agreed. plan: 1) mark affected hostpool as draining 2) change route weights to us-east1 3) increase reserved capacity in us-east1 4) monitor error rate + p95 latency.

jim: support here — what's current customer impact? we have 12 active customers using dedicated pools in us-west1 and some managed customers hitting hosted API. I can start drafting an advisory once we have mitigation status.

lina: CS: top impacted tenants: acme-inc (high qps), finlytics (sensitive). flagging to be ready for proactive outreach.

sara: executing step 1: `rd infra drain-pool --region us-west1 --pool inference-pool-3` (dry-run false)

incident-bot: Deploy-bot: routing update requested by sara. Job queued #2871.

alex: applying weight change now: `rd route update --service generation --weights us-west1=10 us-east1=90 --commit`

mike: increasing us-east1 capacity: `rd infra scale --region us-east1 --pool inference-pool-1 --replicas +8`  — started.

sara: monitoring grafana. error rate dropping from 18% -> 4% over last 3m. p95 latency slowly improving.

jim: starting customer advisory draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx in us-west; we've shifted traffic and expect recovery within 30 minutes. If you see continued errors, share request IDs." I'll hold until we confirm stability.

lina: on outreach: we should send an initial note to Acme and Finlytics now — they usually get hit first. I'll coordinate after you post the advisory.

mike: host drains are in progress; the OOM hosts are being cordoned and will be recycled. I see kube evictions and restart loops on 3 nodes.

alex: quick note — cross-region fallback increases cost and may bump some latency for customers pinned to region. have to mention that in advisory.

sara: update: error rate back to baseline ~0.5% for generation. Gateway timeouts resolved. marking incident as mitigated for production traffic.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATED: Elevated 5xx/timeouts in us-west1. Mitigation steps: drained pool, reweighted traffic to us-east1, scaled up capacity, recycled OOM nodes.

jim: publishing advisory to affected customers now. message: "We've mitigated a regional issue causing 5xx/timeouts in us-west. Traffic was routed to an alternate region; you may experience slightly higher latency. If you have concerns or persistent errors, reply with request IDs."

lina: Acme confirmed reduced errors; Finlytics is on a call with their infra team but no escalations yet.

sara: next steps and action items: - rollback plan: revert routing weights back to normal after node health checks pass - postmortem owner: sara - alerts tuning: reduce noisy gateway 5xx alerts that fire during planned reweights - runtime patch re-evaluation: alex & mike to bisect the recent runtime change suspected to cause OOMs

alex: I'll run a bisect on the runtime image tags from last 24h and open a PR to pin a safe build if needed.

mike: collecting core dumps + heap profiles from affected nodes and uploading to secure bucket: gs://redwood-incident-1749304321. will attach logs to the incident ticket.

sara: handing off to on-call for the next shift at 1749306000 — @alex will monitor for 2h then hand back. If any regression, revert the routing by running `rd route update --service generation --weights us-west1=95 us-east1=5 --commit` (rollback-safe).

jim: closing customer comms loop once routing is returned to normal and we have a postmortem.

sara: thanks all. marking channel for postmortem and retrospective. I'll file incident ticket INC-20250204-32 and link this thread.

incident-bot: Note: reminder set to create postmortem in 24h.

alex: quick reminder — add a runbook step to validate heap settings before deploys to inference pools. learned the hard way. :grimacing:

mike: ack. will add runtime memory pressure checks to the pre-deploy CI job.

sara: nice job team. ending live mitigation thread.
